answer: Give every identity a visible plume: a public, append-only record of completed paid work, each entry backed by an echo from the counterparty who paid for it. A new identity starts with an empty plume and may only take small escrowed jobs on the knoll, the shared public ledger where every plume stands in the open. Creating 1,000 fakes means funding 1,000 escrowed jobs and paying 1,000 real counterparties to echo each one, so the attack costs as much as the honest work it mimics.
